hub.notes: Battery safety: the hub chirps and alerts the app at 3.3V and powers itself off at 3.0V to protect the battery (never during an update; press the button to wake after charging). Simultaneous mode now reports the hub button's own pressed state so the app's Press Hub button shows Done.

node.notes: Battery safety: at 3.3V the node refuses game presses (denied tone + red blip) until charged above 3.4V; at 3.0V it powers off to protect the cell (button wakes it; below 3.05V at boot it goes straight back off). Never fires mid-OTA; a broken battery sensor can never power the node off.
